Copy each identifier directly from the appropriate record. Add the corresponding carrier when the same sequence of digits could belong to different tracking services. A clear label saves the next reader from having to guess which system holds the information.
corrections.translation: 分别填写采购单号、入库编号和国际运单号。国内快递号对应卖家到仓库的运输，国际运单对应仓库寄给收件人的包裹。问题发生在哪一段，就把那一段的号码放在前面，同时附能关联到受影响实物的编号。

corrections.source: If you ordered two similar products, describe the affected variant as well as the product. “Green roll-top pouch, medium, quantity one” is easier to match than “the bag.” Where the original order displays a seller style code, include it alongside your plain-language description. A warehouse label may use the code while the order page uses a translated name. Those two pieces of information allow the agent to follow the same item across records without needing to interpret a photograph of similar green products.
corrections.translation: 买了两个相似商品时，说明缺的是哪个版本。例如“绿色卷口收纳袋，M 码，一只”比“包不见了”更容易对照。若同款不同色来自不同采购明细，应写清各自的编号，不让客服在多条相似记录中猜。

corrections.source: Write the events that materially changed the case. For a parcel received incomplete, this could include the warehouse check, international parcel submission, delivery and first count. Record the local date and add a time zone when comparing events from different countries. Leave out routine notifications that contribute no new fact. Four dated events and an accurate final observation can be easier to act on than a long transcript of every refresh of a tracking page.
corrections.translation: 时间线只写与问题有关的变化。少件可列仓库验货、提交国际包裹、签收及开箱点数的时间。若中途曾要求去掉某件或分箱寄出，也要写上，以免把本来就另寄的物品误判为少装。

corrections.source: A delayed parcel needs a different end point. Record the latest carrier event exactly enough to distinguish an electronic label announcement from physical receipt, and say when you last checked. If the destination carrier has assigned a separate number, provide that record as well. Ask which party can check the next movement and whether the platform needs any action from you. A generic estimate from another buyer's delivery cannot establish the status of your package or the date that a carrier considers it eligible for an investigation.
corrections.translation: 运输延误应以最后一次可确认的承运事件结尾。抄录足以区分电子面单和实际揽件的措辞，并说明最近何时查询。如果目的地承运商另给了单号，也请一并提供。不要把自己预期的到货日期当作已经发生的物流事件。

corrections.source: For missing contents, take one overview showing the received items laid out separately and a second image showing the dispatch contents record. Keep the outer wrapping and any inner packaging while the matter is open. For visible damage, capture the whole item and a closer view of the affected part. A small tear shown alone can be hard to orient. Including a wider shot gives the reviewer a way to locate it and compare it with earlier images.
corrections.translation: 反映缺件时，先拍一张把实收物品分开摆放的全图，再附一张能显示出库清单的记录。保留外箱及面单，若包装有开口或破损，再拍对应细节。不要为了摆得好看而改变现场后，又把重摆图说成开箱原状。

corrections.source: For the pouch example, name the two received colours and show them beside each other. If all pouches were supposed to be nested, say whether you checked inside each one. An overview taken after that check can answer a question staff would otherwise need to send back. If opening a sealed retail package could affect a remedy you are considering, explain the limit of your inspection and ask for guidance. Document the current condition before making any change requested by the agent.
corrections.translation: 收纳袋示例里，列出收到的两种颜色并排拍照。如果多个袋子原本可能套在一起，应注明是否已经检查袋内和夹层。把检查过与仍无法确认的地方分开，让客服知道后续还要查装箱记录还是别处。

corrections.source: A shipping label may contain a name, full street address, phone number and tracking code. Use the support entry point in your account or the contact information identified through the platform's own website or app listing. When sharing an example publicly, remove personal details and readable barcodes from the copy. Retain the original privately in case the authorized support contact requests a specific field for verification. A cropped copy lets you discuss a case without circulating the full delivery label.
corrections.translation: 物流面单经常含姓名、地址、电话和运单号。请通过账户内客服入口或官方当前联系方式提交必要凭据。若要在公开社区描述问题，应遮挡个人信息，不要为说明一个小部件而公开完整地址和其他订单。

corrections.source: Number the attachments and explain what each one shows. For example, the first image shows two pouches in different colours, the second shows the three-line dispatch record and the third shows the outside of the shipping bag at receipt. Say when each image was taken if that affects interpretation. An order screenshot taken after a partial refund might show a different quantity from the purchase confirmation. Supplying the date helps staff understand the apparent discrepancy before spending time investigating the wrong number.
corrections.translation: 附件编号并写一句用途。例如图一显示实际收到的两只袋子和颜色，图二是列三件的出库清单，图三是外箱状况。只提交与这次请求有关的材料，让客服能对应每个问题，而不必从一堆无说明图片里找证据。

corrections.source: Following the pouch example, a practical first request is for staff to compare the final packing entry against the warehouse record for the green item. If they confirm it was never included, ask which options apply and what each would involve. If the packing entry records all three, ask what evidence is needed to continue through the appropriate channel. Keep promises about compensation, replacement or freight out of your own summary unless someone has actually made them for your case.
corrections.translation: 可以先请客服用绿色袋子的入库记录核对最终装箱明细。如确认没有装入，再问可采取什么方案、每个方案需怎样操作；若记录显示三件都装了，则查包装证据与下一段交接。不同调查结果对应不同后续措施。

corrections.source: For a damage case, explain the outcome you need in everyday terms. A cracked buckle might leave a bag unusable even though its fabric looks intact. Say whether you are asking about a replacement part or a remedy for the entire item. Include any seller or parcel protection information attached to the actual transaction. Ask for applicable reporting requirements while the evidence is available. Terms can differ by order and route, so save the response that refers specifically to your parcel.
corrections.translation: 货损要说明实际影响。例如包面料没破，但搭扣裂开后无法正常使用。如果你需要确认能否更换搭扣，就明确说明，而不是只写“包不好”。想整件换、想要配件还是先核实责任，也应与所交证据相符。

corrections.source: Once the request has a reference number, use it for follow-up and keep the conversation in one place when possible. Add new information in a short update. “The destination carrier found a second package under this additional tracking number” immediately changes a missing-item investigation. Reposting the whole original message without calling out that new number makes it harder to see what changed. If a second channel must be used, include the earlier case reference and most recent answer.
corrections.translation: 客服给出查询编号后，后续尽量在同一条记录内更新。新增一张关键照片、一条物流扫描或一项卖家确认，写清它怎样改变原先的问题。避免每次开启全新对话，让接手人员以为有多件彼此无关的问题。

corrections.source: Close the file only when the agreed action can be checked. A replacement being discussed, a replacement with a tracking number and a replacement received are three distinct stages. A refund offered and a credit actually visible in the designated account are also different events. Write a final sentence giving the original discrepancy, the verified result and the date. If a replacement green pouch arrived a week after the other two, the buyer and support agent can both see exactly how the order was completed.
corrections.translation: 达成的处理方案能实际核实后再结案。“在商量补寄”“已生成补寄单号”“替换件已经收到并核对”不是同一阶段。若涉及退款，也应保存真实入账记录，而非只把一次口头答复记为处理完毕。

corrections.source: If someone else accepted the delivery, identify which observations came from that person. For example, a housemate can confirm that the bag was left at reception, while you can confirm the contents you unpacked that evening. Ask the housemate to save any relevant delivery photograph. Attributing each detail to its observer keeps the account accurate when the carrier later asks who physically received the parcel and who first noticed the discrepancy.
corrections.translation: 若由他人代收，应标清消息来源。例如室友能证明包裹当时放在前台，而你能确认当晚开箱看见哪些物品。请代收人保留相关送达照片，别把自己没有当场看到的外箱状况写成亲历事实。

corrections.source: Start with the intended use. If you want a sweatshirt to fit over a shirt, find a sweatshirt you already wear that way. A close-fitting T-shirt may have the same printed size but will be a poor reference for how much room you need. Zip or button comparable garments as you normally wear them and lay them flat without stretching. Smooth wrinkles that would distort a reading while preserving the natural shape. Write down which reference garment you used so that a second measurement can be reproduced.
corrections.translation: 从穿着目的选择参考衣物。想找一件能罩在衬衫外的卫衣，就选平时确实这样穿的卫衣测量。贴身 T 恤即使标同一码，也可能因版型与用途完全不同而给出误导性的参考。

corrections.source: Identify the fit problem you are trying to avoid. A sweatshirt can have enough chest room yet feel short when you raise your arms. A jacket can close comfortably yet pull across the upper back when you reach forward. Choose two or three measurements relevant to that problem. A single size code or overall impression is rarely enough. A record giving flat chest width, back length and sleeve method lets you compare seller charts without assuming that all brands build a garment to the same proportions.
corrections.translation: 写出最想避免的问题：胸部太紧、抬手时衣身太短、坐下后下摆不舒服，还是袖口位置不对？衣服能扣上并不代表各部位都合适。先确定关键尺寸，才知道该优先量哪里以及该问卖家什么。

corrections.source: Open the original listing linked to the exact style on iTaoBuy. Find the chart, diagram or image associated with that style, not a chart for another model shown elsewhere in the gallery. Translated headings are useful starting points, but diagrams can reveal where the measurement begins and ends. Look for units and whether the dimensions describe the garment itself or a recommended wearer. If the heading and diagram appear inconsistent, save both and ask which method the seller used.
corrections.translation: 打开 iTaoBuy 所选款式对应的卖家原始页面，找与该款相关的表格和测量图。某家店内另一款的尺码表不能自动套用。保存示意图和单位；若表格缺少图示，可问卖家从哪里量到哪里。

corrections.source: For example, a line drawn from one underarm seam to the other across a flat garment describes a width. A circumference refers to the distance around the garment or wearer, depending on the chart. A seller might also describe a recommended body range, such as a range of chest measurements intended for a particular size. Doubling a flat garment width produces an approximate garment circumference under simple assumptions. It does not automatically create a recommended body measurement or account for stretch, lining and the ease built into the design.
corrections.translation: 如果图上画的是衣服平铺后从一侧腋缝到另一侧的直线，这一项是宽度；围度指绕一圈的长度。另一些表给的是建议人体数据。在同一张表里也应按每列实际定义读取，不能只看都译成“胸围”。

corrections.source: Back length can be measured from the collar seam, from the high point of the shoulder or from another named point in a seller diagram. A ribbed collar or raised hood seam can add confusion if you start from its outer edge. Measure your reference sweatshirt using the seller's illustrated endpoints. If the garment tapers or has a curved hem, note whether the endpoint is at the centre back or side. A measurement to the shortest part of the hem cannot be fairly compared with one to the longest point.
corrections.translation: 后衣长有的从后领缝量，有的从肩部最高点量，也可能采用卖家自定的起点。罗纹领、翘起的领片和下摆会改变读数。把参考衣物放平，按卖家示意量一次，同时记录是否包含领高。

corrections.source: Sleeves need similar care. A conventional shoulder seam gives a recognizable starting point. A dropped shoulder moves that seam down the arm. A raglan sleeve runs towards the neckline and may have no conventional shoulder seam at all. Two sleeves of equal measured length from their respective arm seams can therefore place the cuff differently on the wearer. Ask for neck-to-cuff or another shared method when the cuts differ. Write the method next to the number, even if the seller's chart labels both figures simply “sleeve.”
corrections.translation: 袖长也要核对起点。常规肩缝、落肩和插肩的结构不同，尺寸数字不能不经处理就并列。若示意从领口量到袖口，不能拿另一件的肩缝到袖口当同一项；必要时请卖家或仓库明确量法。

corrections.source: A soft garment changes shape depending on how it is laid out. Ribbed fabric can stretch while the tape is being pulled into place. A folded seam can shorten a measurement by more than the difference between two nearly identical readings. Repeat your reference measurement once with the tape removed between attempts. If your own result changes noticeably, a tiny displayed difference in a chart deserves less confidence than a large difference confirmed by the same method.
corrections.translation: 柔软面料的形状会随摆放而变。罗纹受轻微拉扯就会伸长，卷边也可能缩短平铺读数。让衣服自然铺开，避免拉紧尺带，必要时重测。几个毫米的波动可能来自摆放，不宜马上认定尺码表有误。

corrections.source: Separate uncertainty about measurement from preference about fit. You may be certain that a jacket is four centimetres longer than your current one and still unsure whether you will like the extra length. Conversely, you may know exactly how much extra room you want but lack a reliable reading of the seller's width. In the first case, try comparing with another garment you own. In the second, seek a clearer chart or a measurement photograph before letting a promotional description make the decision for you.
corrections.translation: 区分“尺寸是否量清楚”和“自己喜不喜欢这样穿”。你可能很确定新外套长了四厘米，却仍不确定喜不喜欢；也可能明确想多留一点胸部空间，但没有可靠的实测图。前者要参考穿着体验，后者应先查数据。

corrections.source: The iTaoBuy developer describes warehouse QC photos in its app listing. If a measurement is essential, check the current options for the individual order and ask a specific question. Name the purchase reference, colour and size. Describe how the garment should be positioned, the two points between which the tape should run and the unit to use. Ask for a picture wide enough to show both endpoints and the tape lying flat. A crisp close-up of the final number cannot establish where the measurement began.
corrections.translation: iTaoBuy 应用介绍提到仓库验货照。若一个尺寸会决定是否放行，先查看本单当前可提供的服务，再以采购编号、颜色、尺码提出具体请求：衣服应怎样平放、尺子从哪里到哪里、需要看清哪一端刻度。

corrections.source: Keep at least one image connecting the unit with the size label. This matters if several similar pieces arrived. Compare the warehouse result with your reference and chart using the same convention. If the label is correct but dimensions appear different, describe that discrepancy precisely: ordered medium, medium tag visible, measured back length from collar seam differs from the medium chart using the same endpoints. That gives support an observable question to investigate. Saying only “this looks small” leaves too many explanations open.
corrections.translation: 至少保留一张能将标签与实际衣物对应的照片，尤其是多个近似款同时入仓时。用相同量法对照仓库结果、个人参考衣物及卖家表格。标签正确而实测不同，就描述这项具体差异，不要直接说卖家发错码。

corrections.source: Write a final comparison in ordinary language. It might read, “Option M is close to my sweatshirt across the chest, but the back is shorter by three centimetres using the same collar-to-hem method. Sleeve length remains uncertain because the designs use different seams.” This gives you a reason to order, ask for clarification or choose another listing. It also gives you a useful reference if the seller later edits the chart or another buyer's photograph circulates with an unclear size label.
corrections.translation: 用日常语言留结论，例如“M 的平铺胸宽与我自己的卫衣接近，但按同一起点测量，后背短三厘米。”这样既说清哪些地方接近，也说明哪个差异会影响决定。以后查记录不用重新猜一栏数字表达什么。

corrections.source: For your next search, keep the reference garment and measurement notes rather than memorizing that a particular letter size once fit. Sizes can differ across sellers and options on the same platform. A small set of consistently measured garments is more transferable. When the original chart, selected option, relevant photographs and comparison notes all point to the same conclusion, you can make a much better-informed fit decision without pretending that a spreadsheet or a single image can predict exactly how a garment will feel.
corrections.translation: 下一次找衣服时，保留参考衣物和测量笔记，别只记“上次某个字母码合身”。同一平台的不同卖家、同一卖家的不同款式，尺码都可能变化。几件按一致方法测过的衣物更能沿用。当原始尺码表、购买选项、照片与比较记录指向同一结论时，你能更有依据地选码，但仍无法仅凭表格或单张图片精确预测穿感。

corrections.source: Repeat the reference measurement after lifting and laying down the garment again. If the result changes substantially, describe that uncertainty and check the starting points before deciding between neighbouring sizes.
corrections.translation: 把参考衣物拿起来，再自然铺回去，用同样方法重新测一次。如果两次读数变化很大，先注明这种不确定性，核对尺子的起止点与面料是否被拉伸，再在相邻两个尺码之间作决定。

corrections.source: Product selectors often compress material, colour, size and bundle details into a few words. Preserve the original option labels, isolate the difference between choices and carry the intended version through to your order.
corrections.translation: 两个卖家规格可能在翻译后看起来同名。回到卖家原始选择框，追踪哪个代码、图片、价格或尺码随选择变化，再决定该把哪个版本交给代理购买。

corrections.source: A listing title may combine every version a seller offers. The translated name can describe a whole family of jackets even when the actual choices include a short jacket, long jacket, lined version and unlined version. Open the listing and identify the controls that change the purchasable option. Note which control changes colour, which changes size and which changes model or package. A single combined dropdown may contain several of these dimensions in the same label.
corrections.translation: 商品标题常把多个变体放在一起，显示的译名可能是整条商品页的描述。应在实际规格选择框里点中一个版本，阅读该版本的原文、预览图与可用尺码，再与第二个选项比较。

corrections.source: Imagine two options both translate as “black regular.” One seller label ends in A and the other in B. Their thumbnails differ only in a seam under the pocket. Do not decide that one of the labels is redundant simply because the translated words are identical. Record the full original text, suffix and thumbnail for each. Your immediate goal is to identify what differs between them. Once that difference is known, the translation can be useful again without being asked to carry all of the product identity.
corrections.translation: 假设两个选项都被译成“黑色常规款”，原文分别带 A、B 后缀，而小图只在口袋下方的一条缝线上不同。不能因为译名一样就删掉其中一个；应记下完整原文和对应细节，保留两个独立选项。

corrections.source: Select the first style while keeping other controls fixed. Record the main image, unit price, available sizes and any model code. Switch to the second style and repeat. If the size resets or becomes unavailable, note it. A size offered in one style does not necessarily remain selectable in another. When a seller uses separate colour and finish controls, avoid changing both in the same step; otherwise you will not know which control changed the picture or price.
corrections.translation: 先保持尺码等其他选择不变，选第一款，记录主图、当前单价、可选尺码和型号。切到第二款时重复一次，留意尺码是否被重置或变成缺货。第一款有的尺码不一定仍属于第二款的有效选择。

corrections.source: If the photo changes from a jacket with a plain hood to one with a contrasting hood, that provides a promising lead. Check whether the text, detail gallery or seller description confirms the association. Some listings reuse a single gallery for every option. Conversely, a changed price may indicate a difference in included pieces rather than material quality. Treat each changed element as evidence about a specific property, not as conclusive proof of all the other properties you hope the version includes.
corrections.translation: 若切换后变成拼色帽子，原本是同色帽子，这是一条有用线索。再查详情和卖家文字是否明确把该帽子对应到这个选项。有的商品页所有版本共用一套图库；反过来，切图也可能只反映不同拍摄角度。

corrections.source: For instance, “model A, black, two pieces” describes something different from “model B, black, single piece” even though a clipped mobile selector may show only “black.” Expand the selector or open the original marketplace page if available. Take a screenshot that includes the listing context and the complete selected option. A standalone picture of a black swatch cannot identify which of the two bundles you mean. Keep your own readable explanation beside the original text, rather than replacing the original with your preferred translation.
corrections.translation: 例如“A 型黑色，两件装”与“B 型黑色，单件”是不同购买单位，手机界面截短后却可能都只剩“黑色”。展开选择框或打开卖家原始页面，截下同时显示商品编号、选项和件数的画面。

corrections.source: Words such as regular, large and short can describe garment length, bag capacity, frame size or seller-defined model names. A “large” accessory may be physically larger than another version while using the same strap length. A “short” jacket can refer to body length rather than sleeve length. Find the diagram or measurements attached to the selected option. If two versions share a chart, look for a model column or separate headings that identify which rows apply.
corrections.translation: “常规”“大号”“短款”可能分别说版型、包容量、镜框尺寸或店铺自定款名。大号配件也可能只改主体尺寸、背带仍一样长。短款外套可能指衣长，而非所有尺寸都小一号。依卖家对具体款式的定义判断。

corrections.source: Use a hypothetical storage bag as an example. The large black option might be a single large bag, while black set might include two smaller bags. If you need to fit a specific object, the word large is insufficient. Compare opening size, interior dimensions and the count included. An order note such as “large please” could be misread if the seller uses a separate type named Large Set. Combining the original version code with the one deciding measurement supports a much more reliable selection.
corrections.translation: 假设黑色大号收纳袋是一只容量较大的袋子，黑色套装则是两只小袋。若要放进指定物品，只知道“大号”远远不够。应比较开口、内部尺寸和每份件数。相似的中文标签不能回答哪个版本实际符合用途。

corrections.source: A useful purchase note identifies the listing, exact original option, required quantity and what should happen if it is unavailable. Adding a concise description can resolve ambiguity: “version B, second dark swatch, single jacket with contrast hood.” If the seller changes the order of the swatches after you save the note, the code and construction description remain helpful. Avoid relying on position alone. Also avoid authorizing a substitution by using broad wording such as “anything similar is fine” unless you truly accept the possible differences.
corrections.translation: 采购备注写商品编号、选项原文、数量及缺货怎么办，可再加一句有辨识力的描述，如“B 版，第二个深色色块，撞色帽单件外套”。注意页面顺序可能调整，色块位置最好与型号和原始文字配合使用。

corrections.source: If several units are involved, list each option separately. For example, specify one model A in medium and two model B in large. Keep the total number of units as a cross-check, but do not let it replace the distribution. Three correct units in the wrong size mix still leave an incorrect order. When the order confirmation appears, compare every line with the note and check the price after selection. Resolve a discrepancy before treating the purchase as settled.
corrections.translation: 涉及多件时逐项写清。例如 A 型 M 码一件，B 型 L 码两件，总数三件作核对。只有总数不能替代规格分布；即使三件都到了，尺码组合不对，采购仍没有按原要求完成。

corrections.source: The developer describes iTaoBuy as an agent that can process marketplace links and provide warehouse QC photographs. When your particular unit arrives, connect the warehouse entry to the corresponding order line. Compare the visible model features with the decision you recorded. A correct-looking black colour does not answer whether the piece is lined, includes the hood option or came with the second accessory. Select the one view that would resolve the remaining uncertainty and ask whether that view is available.
corrections.translation: iTaoBuy 开发者说明介绍了链接代购和仓库验货照片。到仓后，将自己的采购确认与对应实物照片连起来，先看当时区分版本的特征。别人历史买过同款，并不能代替当前这件的标签或结构证据。

corrections.source: For a finish that looks similar under warehouse lighting, a readable option label may be more useful than another distant photograph. For a lining discrepancy, an inside view can show something the label does not. Match the evidence to the property under review. If the unit appears wrong, send the original option and the corresponding visible feature together. Support can then compare what was ordered with what was received, rather than translating an isolated colour word and guessing why you are concerned.
corrections.translation: 色泽或表面处理在仓库光线下很接近时，可读的规格标签可能比再补一张远景更有价值。若疑问是内衬，就请拍内侧及连接部位。补查应围绕尚未确认的那一点，不必把已经看清的外观重复拍一遍。

corrections.source: After the choice is verified, retain the original marketplace identifier, selected option, purchase confirmation and one identifying image of the actual unit. This is a compact archive that remains understandable even if the seller reorganizes the page or the agent changes a translated heading. If you reorder later, recheck availability and the current wording instead of assuming the old swatch position still represents the same product. Listings can change while keeping a familiar cover photograph.
corrections.translation: 确认后将平台商品编号、原始规格、采购确认和一张能识别实物的照片放在一起。卖家以后可能更新名称或替换主图；这些保存下来的记录能说明你下单当时接受的是哪个版本。

corrections.source: The final question is practical: could another person reproduce your intended selection using the information you saved? If they would have to choose between two identical translations with no further clues, the record is incomplete. If they can locate the listing, select the correct model, colour and size, verify the number of pieces and recognize the feature that distinguishes it, the translation has served its purpose. You have converted a vague label into a purchase specification you can actually check.
corrections.translation: 最后做个检验：别人只看这份资料，可以复现你的选择吗？若仍需在两个同译名的色块之间猜，就补上原文代码或图示；若含几件仍说不清，补上销售单位。记录的目的，是让实际采购能按你的意思执行。

corrections.source: “Black and white, please” can describe two opposite designs. Turn a reference picture into an order instruction that identifies the seller option, the position of each colour and the change you would actually authorize.
corrections.translation: “要黑白配色”可能描述两种颜色完全相反的设计。应把参考图转成能执行的购买备注，写清卖家选项、颜色分别落在哪个部位，以及哪些变化需要先征得同意。

corrections.source: Start by opening the exact seller listing. A reference photograph gives a buying agent something to compare, but the available options describe what the seller can actually supply. Identify the marketplace, item number, seller and original option label. If the desired version appears in a gallery but never appears in the selector, treat availability as a question. A seller may keep old product pictures after a version has sold out, or use a group photograph for a listing that offers only some of the pictured designs.
corrections.translation: 打开确切的卖家商品页面。参考图帮助代理识别你想要的外观，而卖家选项决定商家能按哪项发货。若页面上没有可以与参考图对应的选项，不要只凭照片授权“照图购买”，先让卖家确认。

corrections.source: Consider a track jacket with a pale body, black sleeves and a narrow stripe across the chest. A different option reverses the body and sleeve colours. Both may be translated as “black white.” Your note needs to identify the one option and the visible properties that distinguish it. Record the original text, style code and selected thumbnail, then add your own description. The code is useful if the image changes; the description is useful if the code has been translated or clipped.
corrections.translation: 假设运动外套是浅色衣身、黑色袖子、胸前一条细纹，而另一个选项正好把衣身和袖子的颜色对调。两款都可以叫“黑白”。采购备注应区分主体、袖子与条纹，再写上当前卖家选项代码。

corrections.source: Describe the product as a small set of named regions. For the jacket, use body, left sleeve, right sleeve, collar, cuff and stripe as needed. For shoes, use upper, sole, heel and accents. For a bag, distinguish body, base, handles and hardware. Avoid inventing elaborate terms that somebody looking at the item would struggle to recognize. The aim is to reduce ambiguity, not to produce a complete catalogue of every visible colour.
corrections.translation: 把设计分成少量可识别部位。外套可用衣身、左右袖、领、袖口和条纹；鞋子可区分鞋面、鞋底等。只点出足以辨认配色的特征，避免堆上许多容易误读、又不影响区分版本的形容词。

corrections.source: Pick a viewpoint when left and right matter. “Wearer's left” and “left side of the photograph” point to opposite sides in a typical front-facing picture. If the distinction matters, write which one you mean or describe a nearby fixed feature such as a pocket or zip. For the track jacket, “pale front body with black sleeves on both sides” may be sufficient. If there is a single stripe, specify its position relative to the zip or pocket rather than relying on the order of colours in a phrase.
corrections.translation: 左右重要时，明确按“穿着者左侧”还是“照片左边”。正面拍摄时二者通常相反。如果服装本身左右对称，就不必制造方向问题；若只有一侧有徽标或拼色，则把观察视角写入备注。

corrections.source: A screenshot copied from a social feed may be mirrored, tightly cropped or filtered. Look for readable lettering or a closure to establish orientation. Save the uncropped reference alongside any annotated version. If the only visible part is the upper chest, do not assume the back uses the same colour arrangement. Distinguish the features you can see from those you are asking the seller to confirm. This is particularly important when a front and back use intentionally different panels.
corrections.translation: 社交平台的截图可能被镜像、裁边或套滤镜。可用能读出的文字或衣襟方向判断朝向，保留原图且不要随手翻转。看不清方向时直接说明，不把可能经过镜像的参考图当作实物左右的决定性证据。

corrections.source: Use a simple annotation only when it resolves a real ambiguity. For example, point to the narrow charcoal stripe to distinguish it from a black shoulder panel on another version. Avoid covering the exact boundary in the picture. Name files or notes by the option they illustrate, such as “wanted pale-body version” and “alternative dark-body version.” Sending two unlabeled images can make a careful explanation worse if the reader cannot tell whether both depict an acceptable choice or one is an example to avoid.
corrections.translation: 需要标注时只圈出真正容易混淆的地方，例如用箭头指出胸部的炭灰色细条，与肩部黑色拼片区分。另存标注图，不要直接覆盖细节或丢掉原图；代理要能同时看见完整配色和你指的位置。

corrections.source: A seller may use cream, ivory, beige and light grey as separate options. A translation can collapse several labels into similar words. Preserve the seller's exact option alongside your visual description; do not replace it with a personal name for the shade. If the label says ivory and the studio photograph looks white on your screen, state that the ivory option is the one you selected and use the panel position as the deciding clue. Colour perception changes with lighting, surrounding colours and the display.
corrections.translation: 店铺可能把奶油色、象牙白、米色和浅灰分成四个选项，翻译后却很像。保留卖家原称，并单独说明你在图里看到的颜色。光线、滤镜和屏幕会改变观感，不能只凭一处亮面断定卖家用了另一个色号。

corrections.source: When exact shade is essential, decide what evidence would help before ordering. It may be possible to request another picture or seek an existing reference for the same option, but an image still cannot guarantee an exact physical match to an item you already own. Two photos taken under different lights are poor instruments for matching subtle undertones. If you need a perfect match for an existing outfit, acknowledge this remaining uncertainty while deciding whether to proceed or seek a seller with stronger colour evidence.
corrections.translation: 若精确色调是硬性要求，先决定什么证据能帮助你。可以问是否有自然光实拍或同一选项的既有参考，但也要接受不同设备和光照无法保证完全一致。若关键颜色仍未确认，不应把模糊答复写成保证。

corrections.source: The first sentence should specify the listing, original option and quantity. The second can state the visual identifier and any relevant size. A final sentence can state what to do if the option is unavailable. For instance, a buyer could request one medium jacket in the seller's labelled option B, identified by its pale body and black sleeves, and ask to be contacted before any substitution. This supplies a concrete check without asking the agent to guess which property is essential.
corrections.translation: 备注首句写商品链接或编号、规格原文和数量；第二句写关键配色部位及相关尺码；最后说明缺货时是否须先联系。例如愿意看替代款，也应要求先发链接和图片，而不是让代理自行选“很接近”的版本。

corrections.source: If you would accept a substitute, describe it as a separate decision. You might accept the same panel arrangement in another size only after reviewing its chart, or another colour only if the original model and price are unchanged. Simply writing “similar colour okay” could encompass a reversed design that defeats the purpose of the purchase. If you have not reviewed an alternative, ask for its listing and selected option first. Seeing an option and authorizing its purchase are distinct actions.
corrections.translation: 能接受的替代方案要单独写明。也许你愿考虑相同拼色的另一尺码，但须先看它的尺寸表；这不等于可以直接换另一套颜色。若一种变化已授权、另一种仍须确认，应分别标出。

corrections.source: Check the final order summary after submitting the seller link to iTaoBuy. The developer describes the service as reading pasted links and purchasing on request. Verify whether the imported selection still shows the correct option rather than the listing default. Read the quantity and unit price again; some versions of a two-tone design may be sold as a complete set, while another option covers only a jacket. The note supports the selection, but its presence does not correct an accidentally different purchase line.
corrections.translation: 在 iTaoBuy 提交卖家链接后，再查最终订单摘要。开发者介绍的流程是读取粘贴的链接并按要求代购，但导入成功不证明备注和所有选项原封不动。检查配色代码、尺码和数量是否仍是刚才确认的组合。

corrections.source: Save the confirmation with the original option and the short description. If a purchase agent asks for clarification, answer in the same terms instead of switching to another informal name for the colours. If the seller proposes a replacement, compare it region by region. Ask what changed in body colour, sleeve colour, stripe, material and included pieces. A replacement that looks close in a thumbnail may differ exactly where the original description was most important.
corrections.translation: 将最终确认与原规格和简短配色说明保存在一起。若采购代理追问，用相同的部位名和色号答复，不要临时改用一组新的颜色形容词。若选择确实变了，应明确写明新版本替代哪个旧要求。

corrections.source: When warehouse pictures are available, start with an overview of the whole product. For the jacket, verify the relationship between body and sleeves before debating subtle shade. Then inspect the label or seller code if it is visible and compare the selected size. If a feature is hidden, request the specific missing view rather than asking for a general quality check. A back view can answer a back-panel question that ten more close-ups of the front fabric cannot.
corrections.translation: 仓库照片出来后先看实物全貌。以外套为例，先核对衣身和袖子的颜色关系，再看胸前条纹或袖口。若一张图只显示局部，不能证明整件配色倒置；请仓库补一张能同时看到关键部位的画面。

corrections.source: Finish by retaining the purchase reference, the final wording and the photograph of the received unit together. If the correct option arrives, the record tells you exactly which version to seek if you buy again. If the arrangement differs, you can show which region is wrong and which order line defined the expected version. That evidence gives an agent a practical basis for a seller inquiry. A well-written note earns its value twice: once when choosing the option, and again when checking what actually arrived.
corrections.translation: 保留采购编号、确认后的选项原文和对应入库照。收到正确版本时，记录说明哪种描述确实让卖家发对货；若不符，也能指出买的是哪项、实物哪个部位不同，而不用凭记忆争论颜色名称。

corrections.source: Photographs of reversible items deserve an extra label. Describe which side is facing out in the image and whether the opposite side is part of your requested colour combination. A blue exterior with a cream lining is different from a jacket whose left and right outside panels are blue and cream. Use a reference showing the intended wearing position when that distinction affects your purchase.
corrections.translation: 双面可穿商品还要写清照片中哪一面朝外，另一面是不是购买要求的一部分。两张颜色相反的照片可能是同一件衣服翻面，而不一定是两个不同版本。核对结构和规格描述后，再决定要不要分开询价。

corrections.source: Imagine that two screenshots show 12.00 and 12.80 in your preferred currency. You cannot conclude that the second has a worse exchange rate from those figures alone. First inspect the seller price on both. If the first includes 96 yuan of goods and the second includes the same goods plus eight yuan of domestic postage, the higher amount can result from scope even when both use an identical rate. Recalculate from the original components before comparing the conversions themselves.
corrections.translation: 假设两张付款截图以你选的货币显示 12.00 和 12.80。不能只凭后一笔较高就判断汇率变差。先查两张图对应的卖家明细：如果第一张只算 96 元商品，另一张还计入八元国内邮费，应把商品本身与额外费用分开，再比较换算。即使汇率相同，包含不同项目的总额也会不同。
